newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Biggest Colombian power company to invest $1.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Biggest Colombian power company to invest $1.1 bln.

text.p: Colombia's biggest electricity distributor Interconexion Electrica SA ESP said Friday it would invest $1.1 billion between 1997 and the year 2001 on extending its power transmission network.

The state-run company owns 73 percent of Colombia's national power grid and is now looking to extend the network with 330 miles (530 km) of 500,000-volt power lines and 740 miles (1,190 km) of 230,000-volt lines, according to a statement for the president's office.
Interconexion Electrica posted more than 158.4 billion pesos profits, or about $149 million, last year as a result of structural reforms and streamlining.
Earlier this year, the company said it would be looking to sell a 10 to 15 percent stake in the company to private enterprise this year.
